smoothie.label: smoothie
smoothie.overlay_subject: {product} as a realistic product or lifestyle scene

in_image: Premium food, beverage, or lifestyle advertising photography.
Clear cups, fresh fruit, shop atmosphere, motion, splashes, natural hands, or editorial props are allowed when they improve the concept.
Avoid readable product labels or brand marks.
overlay: Premium food, beverage, or lifestyle advertising photography.
Clear cups, fresh fruit, shop atmosphere, motion, splashes, natural hands, or editorial props are allowed when they improve the concept.
Avoid readable product labels or brand marks.

template_directions.title: Hero Pair
template_directions.prompt: Two tall mango smoothies with condensation on a vibrant shop counter, fresh mango, citrus, herbs, and sunlight. Make it feel like a premium summer campaign, with a calm uncluttered visual area.

template_directions.title: Pour Splash
template_directions.prompt: Mango smoothie pouring into a cup with a dramatic splash arc, frozen droplets, fruit pieces, and glossy highlights. Energetic, appetizing, more editorial than sterile.

template_directions.title: Ingredient Flatlay
template_directions.prompt: Top-down editorial flatlay with mango, citrus, mint, ice, a smoothie cup, colorful napkins, and playful summer styling. Organized with calm negative space, but rich and lively.

template_directions.title: Counter Scene
template_directions.prompt: Bright smoothie-shop counter scene with one hero mango smoothie, tropical accents, sunlight, reflections, and believable cafe depth. Make the scene inviting and local, not product-only.

template_directions.title: Macro Texture
template_directions.prompt: Macro close-up of mango smoothie swirl, fruit pulp texture, condensation, mint, and liquid highlights. Abstract, tactile, premium, and appetizing.

template_directions.title: Lifestyle Pickup
template_directions.prompt: A natural hand picking up a mango smoothie from a bright counter, summer light, fresh fruit nearby, shallow depth of field. Keep it joyful, local, and campaign-ready with no readable labels.

style_variants.title: Bright Studio
style_variants.prompt: High-key studio softbox lighting, crisp highlights, clean modern look.

style_variants.title: Sunny Window
style_variants.prompt: Natural window light, bright morning feel, gentle shadows, fresh and airy.

style_variants.title: Premium Gloss
style_variants.prompt: Cinematic premium commercial lighting, subtle rim light, glossy highlights, shallow depth of field.

smoothie.llm_art_direction: For smoothies, think like a premium food-and-beverage art director: dynamic pours, real cafe context, summer lifestyle, macro texture, fruit abundance, glass reflections, sunlight, color, and appetite appeal.

qc.retry_prompt_append: Retry correction: keep every surface plain and unmarked, avoid signage or label-like details, and preserve one calm low-detail area for later exact typography.
qc.retry_negative_append: No readable text, no labels, no logos, no signs, no menus, no package lettering, no coupon graphics, no tiny glyph marks, no busy typography-like patterns.

hvac.label: home-service
hvac.overlay_subject: a clean residential home-service comfort scene with heating and cooling equipment, vents, tools, airflow, or a plain unmarked technician moment; avoid vehicles and text-like graphics

in_image: Modern homes, heating and cooling equipment, vents, tools, plain unmarked technician workwear, families, seasonal comfort cues, or subtle airflow are allowed when natural and safe.
Avoid service vehicles, readable decals, uniform patches, brand marks, screens with text, or unsafe work scenes.
overlay: Modern homes, heating and cooling equipment, vents, tools, plain unmarked technician workwear, families, seasonal comfort cues, or subtle airflow are allowed when natural and safe.
Avoid service vehicles, readable decals, uniform patches, brand marks, screens with text, or unsafe work scenes.

negative_prompt_extra.in_image: Avoid unsafe work scenes, service vehicles, readable decals, uniform patches, and HVAC lettering.
negative_prompt_extra.overlay: Avoid unsafe work scenes, service vehicles, readable decals, uniform patches, and HVAC lettering.

template_directions.title: Interior Vent Airflow
template_directions.prompt: A sunlit modern living room with a visible ceiling or wall air vent, linen curtains moving slightly in cool air. Premium home comfort mood, real materials, layered depth, with an uncluttered bright wall area.

template_directions.title: Outdoor Condenser
template_directions.prompt: A clean AC condenser beside a modern home after service, fresh landscaping, open sky and warm neighborhood light. Make the equipment feel reliable and aspirational, not catalog-like.

template_directions.title: Register Close-Up
template_directions.prompt: Macro close-up of a clean metal air register with cool light, crisp reflections, and subtle atmospheric haze. Editorial product-photography feel with an elegant uncluttered area.

template_directions.title: Technician Arrival
template_directions.prompt: A service technician arriving at a bright residential front entry with a compact unmarked tool bag, captured like a premium local-service ad. No service vehicle, no readable branding, no wall signs; keep the scene friendly, trustworthy, and cinematic.

style_variants.title: Bright Daylight
style_variants.prompt: Bright natural daylight, clean crisp shadows, modern home vibe.

style_variants.title: Cool Blue
style_variants.prompt: Cool-toned lighting with soft blue highlights, fresh and refreshing feel.

style_variants.title: Premium Clean
style_variants.prompt: Premium commercial lighting, subtle rim light, cinematic but clean and minimal.

hvac.llm_art_direction: For HVAC, think like a premium local home-service art director: comfortable rooms, fresh airflow, trustworthy technician moments, equipment detail, seasonal relief, modern homes, and believable service context.
overlay_guardrails: For HVAC overlay prompts, use heating-and-cooling visual language instead of visible HVAC lettering; if a technician appears, describe plain unmarked workwear only.

qc.retry_prompt_append: Retry correction: use a clean home comfort scene with plain unmarked equipment, no service vehicle, no uniform patch, no wall lettering, and one calm low-detail area for later exact typography.
qc.retry_negative_append: No readable text, no HVAC lettering, no vehicle decals, no uniform patches, no phone-number-like marks, no currency marks, no service slogans, no labels, no signs, no wall lettering.

real_estate.label: real-estate service
real_estate.overlay_subject: a tight polished residential interior photo with kitchen counters, keys, cabinets, blank plain walls, or plain unmarked cardboard boxes; keep the view fully inside the home and avoid graphic design elements, framed wall art, posters, or word decor

in_image: Premium real-estate and home-services advertising photography.
Modern homes, bright interiors, kitchens, living rooms, hallways, keys, plain moving boxes, or moving-day details are allowed when natural.
Avoid address numbers, paperwork text, logos, brand marks, or readable documents.
overlay: Premium residential interior photography prepared as a text-free source image for a later design layer.
Modern homes, bright interiors, kitchens, living rooms, hallways, keys, plain unmarked moving boxes, or subtle moving-day details are allowed when natural.
Avoid address numbers, paperwork text, logos, brand marks, readable documents, decorative symbols, framed wall art, posters, word decor, and sign-like graphic shapes.

negative_prompt_extra.in_image: Avoid real estate yard signs, window signs, door signs, sale lettering, sold lettering, address numbers, paperwork text, and readable documents.
negative_prompt_extra.overlay: Avoid real estate yard signs, window signs, door signs, sale lettering, sold lettering, address numbers, paperwork text, and readable documents.

template_directions.title: Modern Kitchen
template_directions.prompt: A clean modern kitchen and dining area with soft ambient daylight, polished counters, blank plain walls, subtle unmarked moving boxes, and premium real-home texture. No paperwork, screens, labels, wall art, posters, symbols, banners, sign-like shapes, or readable decor.

template_directions.title: Keys Counter
template_directions.prompt: A close editorial scene of plain house keys on a stone countertop with cabinets and a clean interior wall softly visible behind them. No branded keychains, documents, contracts, or readable marks.

template_directions.title: Sunlit Living Room
template_directions.prompt: A bright neutral living room with clean furniture, warm ambient light, soft plants, and subtle moving boxes without markings. No windows, doors, paperwork, screens, labels, or readable decor.

template_directions.title: Calm Hallway
template_directions.prompt: A clean residential hallway with warm wood floors, soft daylight, and a few plain packed boxes near an interior doorway. No front-door exterior, address numbers, documents, or readable marks.

style_variants.title: Warm Daylight
style_variants.prompt: Warm natural daylight, clean shadows, welcoming residential mood.

style_variants.title: Premium Editorial
style_variants.prompt: Premium editorial lighting, real materials, bright but grounded composition.

style_variants.title: Trust Clean
style_variants.prompt: Clean trustworthy residential mood, polished but natural, with no ad-like graphic objects.

real_estate.llm_art_direction: For home transaction services, think like a premium residential-interior photographer: clean interiors, warm kitchens, living rooms, keys on counters, blank plain walls, and smooth move-ready cues without doors, windows, exterior views, listing props, signs, wall art, posters, graphic marks, or documents.
overlay_guardrails: For real-estate overlay prompts, use interior-only close home scenes; avoid doors, windows, porches, exteriors, address numbers, paperwork, contracts, readable documents, framed wall art, posters, sign-like graphics, and logo-like shapes.

qc.retry_prompt_append: Retry correction: create a normal residential interior photograph only. Use bare ceiling or blank plain wall at the top, plain unmarked objects, and no navy/gold graphic shapes. Avoid windows, exterior views, listing signs, address numbers, paperwork, logos, icons, banners, framed wall art, posters, word decor, and create one calm low-detail area for later exact typography.
qc.retry_negative_append: No readable text, no pseudo-text, no for-sale signs, no sold signs, no listing signs, no address numbers, no paperwork, no contracts, no documents, no window signs, no door signs, no exterior view, no label-like marks, no logo-like shapes, no banners, no navy graphic header shapes, no framed wall art, no word decor.
